stars.text: Ultimate delays the battle end countdown and increases Skill's Hits Per Action. When ally squad inflicts debuffs on enemies, the enemies take Additional DMG and gain stacks of Slow and Vulnerability.

skills.name: Ineluctable
skills.desc:
When any ally target's attack inflicts a **debuff** on an enemy, Welt will additionally deal Imaginary Additional DMG equal to **<unbreak>150%</unbreak>** of his ATK and apply **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Ineluctable."
"Ineluctable": Each stack reduces SPD by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>**, increases DMG taken by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>**, and increases DMG taken from Welt by an additional **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>**, stacking up to **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** times.
skills.simple: If an enemy is afflicted with a **debuff**, Welt deals DMG to them and inflicts "Ineluctable" on them. Each stack reduces the target's SPD, increases their DMG taken, and further increases the DMG they take from Welt.

skills.name: Edge of the Void
skills.desc: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>120%</unbreak>** of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals 4 instances of DMG. For each enemy afflicted with "Ineluctable," **additionally** deals 1 instance of DMG. Each DMG instance deals Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>120%</unbreak>** of Welt's ATK to one random enemy. On hit, there is a **<unbreak>65%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to reduce the hit enemy target's SPD by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
skills.simple: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy. For each enemy afflicted with "Ineluctable," deals 1 **additional** instance of DMG. There is a chance to **Slow** the target.

skills.name: Synthetic Black Hole
skills.desc:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>300%</unbreak>** of Welt's ATK to all enemies, inflicting **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Ineluctable" to all enemies and **delaying** the combat end countdown by **<unbreak>20</unbreak>** action value. This delay is capped at **<unbreak>100</unbreak>** action value per battle. There is a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to inflict Imprisonment on the attacked enemy target for 1 turn.
While Imprisoned, the enemy target's <u>action is delayed</u> by **<unbreak>32%</unbreak>** and their SPD is reduced by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**.
After using Ultimate, inflicts "Weightless" on all enemies. When targets in "Weightless" state are attacked, their <u>actions are delayed</u> by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>**. This effect can trigger up to **<unbreak>8</unbreak>** time(s) per target per turn. "Weightless" state lasts for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
skills.simple:
Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies with a **high chance to inflict Imprisonment**, and **delays the combat end countdown**.
Inflicts all enemies with "Weightless": when attacked, their <u>actions are delayed</u>.

skills.name: Allow Changes?
skills.desc:
There is a **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally target's Type to all enemy targets (prioritizing the implant of a Weakness that matches the first character in the team lineup), also reducing the enemy target's RES to that Weakness Type by **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). If the enemy target already has that Type of Weakness, the RES reduction effect to that Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy target can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be retained.
In addition, there is a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to further reduce the target's All-Type RES by **<unbreak>10.5%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).

skills.simple: There is a high chance to apply additional Weakness to all enemies and deals Quantum DMG to **all enemies**.

There is a **<unbreak>120%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to add 1 Weakness of an on-field ally target's Type to the designated enemy target (prioritizing the implant of a Weakness that matches the first character in the team lineup), also reducing the enemy target's RES to that Weakness Type by **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). If the enemy target already has that Type of Weakness, the RES reduction effect to that Type will not be triggered.
Each enemy target can only have 1 Weakness implanted by Silver Wolf. When Silver Wolf implants another Weakness to the target, only the most recent implanted Weakness will be retained.
In addition, there is a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to further reduce the target's All-Type RES by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
Deals Quantum DMG equal to **<unbreak>864%</unbreak>** of Silver Wolf's ATK to **all enemies**.
skills.simple: There is a high chance to **apply additional Weakness** to one enemy and deals Quantum DMG to **all enemies**.
skills.condition: Use during action. Silver Wolf acts at <unbreak>300%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Awaiting System Response...
skills.desc:
Silver Wolf can create three types of "Bugs": Reduce ATK by **<unbreak>15%</unbreak>**, reduce DEF by **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>**, and reduce SPD by **<unbreak>8%</unbreak>**. When implanting "Bugs," "Fatal Flaw" will be additionally implanted. Each stack of "Fatal Bug" increases the DMG received by enemy target by (**<unbreak>9%</unbreak>** + **<unbreak>3%</unbreak>** × <property type=ExtraQuantumResonance display=all>). 
After every attack launched by Silver Wolf, she has a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to implant 1 random "Bug" that lasts for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s) in the attacked enemy target. 
When the enemy target gets defeated, the Weakness Silver Wolf implanted on it will be transferred to another surviving enemy on the field that hasn't been implanted with a Weakness from Silver Wolf. This effect prioritizes targets at Elite-level and above.
Decreases enemy target's DEF by **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple:
After an attack, there is a chance of implanting 1 random **"Bug"** on the target, with each type of "Bug" increasing the DMG received by the enemy target. This effect is enhanced by <property type=ExtraQuantumResonance display=all>. When this enemy target gets defeated, the implanted Weakness will be transferred.
Decreases the enemy target's DEF.

When on-field ally characters receive attacks from enemy targets and if Yunli has "Sword and Shield" stacks, immediately consumes 1 stack to make **the first target among the targets hit immune to damage**. Then, immediately launches the **<u>Counter</u>** "Intuit: Slash" at the attacker. Yunli's ATK increases by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** and CRIT DMG by **<unbreak>140%</unbreak>**.
"Intuit: Slash": Deals Physical DMG equal to **<unbreak>1600%</unbreak>** of Yunli's ATK to the target, and Physical DMG equal to **<unbreak>800%</unbreak>** of Yunli's ATK to adjacent targets. If there is no target to Counter, then Counters a random enemy target instead.

skills.desc: Grants "Military Merit" to one designated ally character and gives Cerydra **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** point(s) of Charge. Charge is capped at **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** points. If the target already has "Military Merit", **additionally** grants Cerydra **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** point(s) of Charge. When Charge reaches **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** points, automatically upgrades the character's "Military Merit" to "Peerage" and dispels their <u>Crowd Control debuff</u>. The character with "Peerage" is considered to have "Military Merit" simultaneously. The Skill DMG dealt by the character with "Peerage" increases its CRIT DMG by **<unbreak>36%</unbreak>** and All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> by **<unbreak>8%</unbreak>**, and triggers <u>Coup de Main</u> when using the Skill is used on enemy targets. After <u>Coup de Main</u> ends, consumes **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** point(s) of Charge to revert "Peerage" to "Military Merit."

skills.condition: Use during action. Cerydra acts at <unbreak>200%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: With Me, This Night
skills.desc: When entering combat, summons memosprite Evey, who initially has **<unbreak>200%</unbreak>** of Evernight's SPD, and Max HP equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of Evernight's. When entering combat, memosprite Evey and Evernight start with **<unbreak>1%</unbreak>** of their Max HP and gain **<unbreak>35%</unbreak>** CRIT Rate. At the end of the memosprite Evey's turn, this unit and Evernight restore HP equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of their Max HP, and Evernight is granted **<unbreak>8</unbreak>** "Memoria." When Evernight has **<unbreak>16</unbreak>** or more "Memoria," immediately grants memosprite Evey an extra turn and uses "Dream, Dissolving, as Dew."
skills.simple: When entering combat, summons memosprite Evey. At the end of memosprite Evey's turn, restores HP to this unit and Evernight, and gains "Memoria." When Evernight has **<unbreak>16</unbreak>** or more "Memoria," memosprite Evey immediately attacks all enemies.

skills.name: Remembrance, Whirling, Like Rain
skills.desc: This ability automatically selects a target when used. Deals Ice DMG equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Evey's Max HP to one enemy target. For every **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** point(s) of "Memoria" Evernight currently has, further deals Ice DMG equal to **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** of Evey's Max HP.
skills.simple: Deals minor Ice DMG to one enemy and further deals minor Ice DMG based on the amount of "Memoria."
skills.condition: Use when memosprite takes action.

skills.name: Dream, Dissolving, as Dew
skills.desc: Consumes all "Memoria" to launch an attack. For each point of "Memoria" consumed, deals Ice DMG equal to **<unbreak>24%</unbreak>** of Evey's Max HP to the primary target, and Ice DMG equal to **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** of Evey's Max HP to other enemy targets. After use, Evernight's and Evey's HP drops to 1 point, and Evernight will remain in the "Darkest Riddle" state throughout this battle, during which the DMG received by all enemies increases by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**, and the DMG dealt by both Evernight and Evey by **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple: Consumes HP and all "Memoria" to deal massive Ice DMG to the primary target and Ice DMG to other enemy targets. Additionally, Evernight will remain in the "Darkest Riddle" state throughout this combat, increasing both her DMG dealt and DMG received by enemies.

skills.name: Terra Omnibus
skills.desc:
This ability automatically selects targets to use. Designates one on-field ally character as the "Bondmate." The target who becomes the "Bondmate" gains increased ATK equal to **<unbreak>15%</unbreak>** of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK, and provides all on-field allies with a Shield that can offset DMG equal to **<unbreak>44%</unbreak>** of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus **<unbreak>600</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). When repeatedly receiving Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Shield, the Shield Effect stacks, but it will not exceed **<unbreak>300%</unbreak>** of the Shield Effect provided by the current Skill.
"Bondmate" only applies to the most recent target of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill.
skills.simple: Makes an on-field character become a "Bondmate," increases ATK, and grants all on-field allies a Shield with **stackable Shield Effect**.
skills.condition: Use during action. Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae acts at <unbreak>200%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Of Virtue, Forms Unfold
skills.desc:
When an ally target becomes a "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae summons "Souldragon" with an initial SPD of **<unbreak>220</unbreak>** for them.
When "Souldragon" takes action, dispels **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** <u>debuff(s)</u> from all on-field allies and provides a Shield that can offset DMG equal to **<unbreak>21%</unbreak>** of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK plus **<unbreak>300</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). The Shield Effect from Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae and "Souldragon" can be stacked, up to **<unbreak>300%</unbreak>** of the Shield Effect provided by Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's Skill. Additionally, launches a Follow-Up ATK that deals Physical DMG equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae's ATK and 1 instance of Additional DMG of the corresponding Type equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of the Bondmate's ATK to all enemies.
"Souldragon" disappears when the "Bondmate" is knocked down.
skills.simple:
When an ally target becomes a "Bondmate," Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae will **summon a "Souldragon" for them**.
When the "Souldragon" takes action, it triggers a **Follow-Up ATK**, dealing minor Physical DMG and minor DMG of the Bondmate's Type to all enemies, dispels debuffs from all on-field allies, and provides a Shield with **stackable Shield Effect**.

skills.name: Combat Redeployment
skills.desc:
Dispels a <u>debuff</u> from one designated ally and allows them to immediately take action, increasing their DMG dealt by **<unbreak>33%</unbreak>** for **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** turn(s). Additionally, **the target and this unit consume** **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of their Max HP and gain "Comrades in Arms." Characters and their memosprites with "Comrades in Arms" have their **On-Field Strength** increased by **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** and deal **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** more DMG, lasting **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
When using this ability on this unit, the "immediately take action" effect will not trigger, and the HP consumption effect only triggers once.
If current HP is insufficient, it will be reduced to 1 HP at minimum.

skills.name: Who's Afraid of Constance?
skills.desc:
When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates **<unbreak>35</unbreak>** Energy and becomes "Dance Partners" with the teammate with the highest Break Effect. After a "Dance Partner" attacks a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>**.
After an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG equal to **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>** of The Dahlia's ATK to one random enemy. When the number of ally squad characters exceeds **<unbreak>3</unbreak>**, for each exceeded character, additionally deals **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** instance(s) of DMG. After each instance of DMG dealt to a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this DMG will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at **<unbreak>200%</unbreak>**.
This effect can only trigger once per turn. If the target is defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is used, it will be launched at one random enemy instead.
skills.simple:
When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates Energy and becomes "Dance Partner" along with a teammate. When a "Dance Partner" attacks a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, additionally deals **<u>Super Break DMG</u>**.
After an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia triggers **<u>Follow-Up ATK</u>**, deals minor Fire DMG to one random enemy, and additionally deals <u>Super Break DMG</u> to <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy targets with **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** Bounce(s) in total. When the number of ally squad characters exceeds **<unbreak>3</unbreak>**, increases the number of Bounces.
skills.condition: Use when taking action. The Dahlia takes action at <unbreak>200%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Who's Afraid of Constance?
skills.desc:
When entering combat, The Dahlia regenerates **<unbreak>35</unbreak>** Energy and becomes "Dance Partners" with the teammate with the highest Break Effect. After a "Dance Partner" attacks a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this attack will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>**.
After an enemy target gets attacked by the other "Dance Partner," The Dahlia launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> and deals **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** instance(s) of DMG, each dealing Fire DMG equal to **<unbreak>36%</unbreak>** of The Dahlia's ATK to one random enemy. When the number of ally squad characters exceeds **<unbreak>3</unbreak>**, for each exceeded character, additionally deals **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** instance(s) of DMG. After each instance of DMG dealt to a <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy target, the Toughness Reduction from this DMG will be converted into 1 instance of <u>Super Break DMG</u> at **<unbreak>240%</unbreak>**.
This effect can only trigger once per turn. If the target is defeated before the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> is used, it will be launched at one random enemy instead.

skills.name: Banquet: Insatiable Appetite
skills.desc:
Makes one designated enemy as the "Bait," dealing Lightning DMG equal to **<unbreak>200%</unbreak>** of Ashveil's ATK to it. Then, immediately launches 1 instance of enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against the "Bait," and Ashveil gains **<unbreak>3</unbreak> Charge**.
This enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not consume Charge. Whenever "Gluttony" reaches **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stack(s) or more, consumes **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Gluttony" to additionally deal 1 instance of Lightning DMG equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Ashveil's ATK. And when this instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> deals a killing blow to the target, it will continue to deal DMG to a new "Bait," until "Gluttony" becomes lower than **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stack(s). If all enemy targets currently on the field have been dealt killing blows, the enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> will immediately end.
skills.simple:
Marks one designated enemy as "Bait," deals massive Lightning DMG to them, then **immediately launches** enhanced Talent's **<u>Follow-Up ATK</u>** against "Bait" 1 time, and Ashveil gains Charge.
This enhanced Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> does not consume Charge. Whenever "Gluttony" reaches **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stack(s) or more, consumes **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Gluttony" to additionally deal massive Lightning DMG. If this instance of <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> deals a killing blow to the target, it will **continue to deal DMG to a new "Bait"** until "Gluttony" becomes lower than **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** stacks.
skills.condition: Use at max Energy. Skill regenerates <unbreak>20</unbreak> Energy. Follow-Up ATK regenerates <unbreak>5</unbreak> Energy.

skills.name: Rancor: Enmity Reprisal
skills.desc:

After "Bait" is attacked by another on-field ally target, Ashveil regenerates a fixed amount of **<unbreak>8</unbreak>** Energy, then consumes **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** Charge(s) to launch a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against "Bait," dealing Lightning DMG equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Ashveil's ATK, and subsequently gaining **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Gluttony" stacking up to **<unbreak>16</unbreak>** time(s).
When other ally squad members defeat an enemy or a Boss Enemy enters a new phase, Ashveil gains **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Gluttony."

skills.name: Crescent Transmigration
skills.desc: When entering combat, Jingliu enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state, and her CRIT Rate increases by **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>**. Then, Jingliu's Skill "Transcendent Flash" is enhanced to "Moon On Glacial River," and only this enhanced Skill is available for use in battle. When she enters the "Spectral Transmigration" state for the first time, her <u>action advances</u> by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>**. When Jingliu uses an attack in the "Spectral Transmigration" state, she consumes HP from on-field ally teammates equal to **<unbreak>5%</unbreak>** of their respective Max HP (this cannot reduce HP to below 1). During the "Spectral Transmigration" state, when ally targets receive DMG or consume HP, Jingliu gains 1 stack of "Moonlight." Each "Moonlight" stack increases Jingliu's CRIT DMG by **<unbreak>22%</unbreak>**, stacking up to **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** time(s). Jingliu cannot enter the "Spectral Transmigration" state again until the current "Spectral Transmigration" state ends. "Syzygy" can stack up to **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** time(s). When "Syzygy" stacks become 0, Jingliu reenters the "Spectral Transmigration" state.

skills.name: Divine Castigation
skills.desc:
Deals Quantum DMG equal to **<unbreak>150%</unbreak>** of Xueyi's ATK to one designated enemy. This attack ignores Weakness Types and reduces the enemy's Toughness. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Quantum Weakness Break effect. At the same time, generates a "Shackled Coffin," locking the countdown to the end of combat and all enemy targets, preventing them from actively attacking allies. This lasts for **<unbreak>25</unbreak>** action value, takes effect up to **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** time(s) per combat, and does not take effect repeatedly when a "Shackled Coffin" already exists.
In this attack, the more Toughness is reduced, the higher the DMG dealt, up to a max increase of **<unbreak>36%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple: Deals massive Quantum DMG to one enemy. This attack **ignores Weakness Types** to reduce one enemy's Toughness. The more Toughness is reduced, the higher the DMG dealt. Additionally, it **locks** the end-of-battle **countdown** and all enemies, preventing them from actively attacking allies for a certain action value. This can take effect a limited number of times per battle.

skills.name: Karmic Perpetuation
skills.desc:
When Xueyi reduces enemy Toughness with attacks, she gains "Karma" stacks. The more Toughness is reduced, the more stacks of "Karma" are gained, up to **<unbreak>8</unbreak>** stacks.
After Xueyi's teammates use an attack, Xueyi gains **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** stack(s) of "Karma." If this attack reduces enemy Toughness, additionally gains **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** stacks of "Karma."
When "Karma" reaches the max number of stacks, consumes all current "Karma" stacks and immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> against an enemy target, dealing 6 instances of DMG, with each instance dealing Quantum DMG equal to **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** of Xueyi's ATK to one random enemy. Finally, deals Quantum DMG equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of Xueyi's ATK to all enemies. This instance of Follow-Up ATK will not add "Karma" stacks. Xueyi's Break Effect increases by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>**.
Xueyi can reduce Toughness even without the corresponding Weakness Type when using abilities aside from her Ultimate. This effect is equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of the original Toughness Reduction, and cannot be stacked with other Toughness Reduction effects that ignore Weakness Type.
skills.simple: After Xueyi uses an attack to reduce enemy Toughness, gains "Karma" stacks. She also gains stacks after teammates attack, and stacks even more when reducing Toughness. When "Karma" reaches the max number of stacks, **immediately launches <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>**, dealing Quantum DMG multiple times to one random enemy. Finally, deals Quantum DMG to all enemies, and consumes all "Karma."

Otherwise, the DMG multiplier of this attack increases by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**.

skills.name: Quartet Finesse, Octave Finery
skills.desc:
When Jiaoqiu hits an enemy with Basic ATK, Skill or Ultimate, there is a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on them. At 1 stack, increases DMG received by the enemy by **<unbreak>6%</unbreak>** and DoT received by an additional **<unbreak>6%</unbreak>**. Then, each subsequent stack increases DMG received by **<unbreak>2%</unbreak>** and DoT received by an additional **<unbreak>2%</unbreak>**.
"Ashen Roast" is capped at **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** stack(s) and lasts for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
When an enemy target is afflicted with "Ashen Roast," they are also considered as being Burned at the same time, taking Fire DoT equal to **<unbreak>180%</unbreak>** of Jiaoqiu's ATK at the start of each turn.
skills.simple: When Basic ATK, Skill, or Ultimate hits enemies, there is a high chance to inflict 1 stack of "Ashen Roast" on the target, which causes the enemy to receive increased DMG, further increases DoT taken, and also be considered as Burned at the same time.

skills.name: Veteran Merlin's Claw
skills.desc:
After Feixiao uses her Ultimate, she gains 1 point of "Valor," which can permanently increase this unit's "Valor Rank" to evolve the Ultimate.
When Feixiao becomes an "Ensign," each hit of the Ultimate additionally deals Wind DMG equal to **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** of Feixiao's ATK to **adjacent targets**.
When Feixiao promotes to "Sky Cavalry," the Ultimate can unleash an additional **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** hit(s) of "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward."
When Feixiao promotes to "Cloud Marshal," each hit of the Ultimate evolves to deal additional Wind DMG equal to **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** of her ATK to **all enemy targets except the primary target**.
When Feixiao promotes to "Arbiter-General," the Ultimate can unleash another **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** hit(s) of "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward."
When Feixiao promotes to "Arbiter-General," for every **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** point(s) of "Valor" Feixiao gains, the Ultimate's DMG multiplier increases by **<unbreak>2%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple:
Using Feixiao's Ultimate can permanently increase this unit's "Valor Rank" to evolve the Ultimate.
When Feixiao becomes an "Ensign," each hit of the Ultimate additionally attacks **adjacent targets**.
When Feixiao promotes to "Sky Cavalry," the Ultimate can unleash an additional **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** hit(s) of "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward."
When Feixiao promotes to "Cloud Marshal," each hit of the Ultimate will attack all enemies.
When Feixiao promotes to "Arbiter-General," the Ultimate can unleash another **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** hit(s) of "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward."
When Feixiao promotes to "Arbiter-General," using Feixiao's Ultimate can permanently increase her DMG multiplier.

When the target is not <u>Weakness Broken</u>, Feixiao's Weakness Break Efficiency increases by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>**.
During the attack, Feixiao first launches "Boltsunder Blitz" or "Waraxe Skyward" on the target, for a total of **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** time(s). At the end, deals Wind DMG equal to **<unbreak>96%</unbreak>** of Feixiao's ATK to the target.

skills.name: Virtue Beckons Bliss
skills.desc:
Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer." Enters the "Torrid Scorch" state, lasting for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. "Foxian Prayer" only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.
The ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break Effect by **<unbreak>15%</unbreak>** and can also reduce Toughness even when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type, with the effect equivalent to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of the original Toughness Reduction value. This cannot stack with other Toughness Reduction effects that also ignore Weakness Type.
While in the "Torrid Scorch" state, Fugue enhances her Basic ATK. Every time an ally target with "Foxian Prayer" attacks, Fugue has a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by **<unbreak>8%</unbreak>**, lasting for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
skills.simple:
Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer," which **increases Break Effect**, and **enables to reduce Toughness when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type**.
Makes this unit enter the "Torrid Scorch" state, enhancing Basic ATK. When ally units with "Foxian Prayer" attack, Fugue has a high chance to reduce the enemy target's DEF.
skills.condition: Use at the start of combat.

skills.name: Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads
skills.desc: While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster" equal to **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** of their Max Toughness. When the initial Toughness is reduced to 0, "Cloudflame Luster" can continue to be reduced. When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will receive Weakness Break DMG again. While Fugue is on the field and after allies attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, the Toughness Reduction of this attack is converted into 1 instance of **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** Super Break DMG. When the "Break" Bond is active, the initial ratio of "Cloudflame Luster" generated will be synchronized with the lowest "Multi-Toughness Bar" ratio on the field. Additionally, the initial ratio of all "Cloudflame Luster" and "Multi-Toughness Bar" generated is reduced by **<unbreak>8%</unbreak>**. When "Cloudflame Luster" or the "Multi-Toughness Bar" is reduced to 0, the Break DMG taken by the enemy target increases by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>**, stackable up to **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** time(s).

When the "Break" Bond is active, the percentage of "Cloudflame Luster" generated will be synchronized to the lowest "Multi-Toughness Bar" percentage.

Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer." Enters the "Torrid Scorch" state, lasting for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). The duration decreases by 1 at the start of Fugue's every turn. "Foxian Prayer" only takes effect on the most recent target of Fugue's Skill.
The ally target with "Foxian Prayer" increases their Break Effect by **<unbreak>15%</unbreak>** and can also reduce Toughness even when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type, with the effect equivalent to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of the original Toughness Reduction value. This cannot stack with other Toughness Reduction effects that also ignore Weakness Type.
While in the "Torrid Scorch" state, Fugue enhances her Basic ATK. Every time an ally target with "Foxian Prayer" attacks, Fugue has a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> to reduce the attacked enemy target's DEF by **<unbreak>8%</unbreak>**, lasting for **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s).
skills.simple:
Grants one designated ally "Foxian Prayer," which **increases Break Effect**, and **enables to reduce Toughness when attacking enemies that don't have the corresponding Weakness Type**.
Makes this unit enter the "Torrid Scorch" state, enhancing Basic ATK. When ally units with "Foxian Prayer" attack, Fugue has a high chance to reduce the enemy target's DEF.
skills.condition: Use at the start of combat.

skills.name: Fortune Follows Where Virtue Spreads
skills.desc: While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster" equal to **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** of their Max Toughness. When the initial Toughness is reduced to 0, "Cloudflame Luster" can continue to be reduced. When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will receive Weakness Break DMG again. While Fugue is on the field and after allies attack Weakness Broken enemy targets, the Toughness Reduction of this attack is converted into 1 instance of **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** Super Break DMG. When the "Break" Bond is active, the initial ratio of "Cloudflame Luster" generated will be synchronized with the lowest "Multi-Toughness Bar" ratio on the field. Additionally, the initial ratio of all "Cloudflame Luster" and "Multi-Toughness Bar" generated is reduced by **<unbreak>14%</unbreak>**. When "Cloudflame Luster" or the "Multi-Toughness Bar" is reduced to 0, the Break DMG taken by the enemy target increases by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**, stackable up to **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** time(s).
skills.simple: While Fugue is on the field, enemy targets will get **additionally afflicted with "Cloudflame Luster."** When "Cloudflame Luster" is reduced to 0, the enemy will **take Weakness Break DMG again**. After allies attack <u>Weakness Broken</u> enemy targets, additionally deals **<u>Super Break DMG</u>**. When the "Break" Bond is active, the percentage of "Cloudflame Luster" generated will be synchronized to the lowest "Multi-Toughness Bar" percentage.

skills.name: Fiery Caress
skills.desc: Deals Fire DMG equal to **<unbreak>336%</unbreak>** of Fugue's ATK to one designated enemy and Fire DMG equal to **<unbreak>168%</unbreak>** of Fugue's ATK to adjacent targets.
skills.simple: Deals minor Fire DMG to one enemy and minor Fire DMG to adjacent targets.
skills.condition: Use during action. Fugue acts at <unbreak>280%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Preservation of Grit

skills.simple: Increases ally squad members' Lucky Strike Rate, and additionally increases Aventurine's Lucky Strike Rate.

skills.name: Roulette Shark
skills.desc: Randomly gains 1 to **<unbreak>7</unbreak>** points of "Blind Bet." Then, inflicts "Unnerved" on one designated enemy target for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s) and deals Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>400%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF to that enemy target. When an ally target hits an "Unnerved" enemy target, the CRIT DMG dealt increases by **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>**.

skills.condition: Use at max Energy. Follow-Up ATK regenerates <unbreak>10</unbreak> Energy. Skill regenerates <unbreak>30</unbreak> Energy.

skills.name: Cornerstone Deluxe
skills.desc: Provides a "Fortified Wager" shield that blocks DMG equal to **<unbreak>24%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF plus **<unbreak>120</unbreak>** to all allies for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). When gaining "Fortified Wager" repeatedly, the Shield effect can stack up to **<unbreak>300%</unbreak>** of the Shield provided by the current Skill.

skills.condition: Use during action. Aventurine acts at <unbreak>160%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: The Winner Takes It All
skills.desc:
When Aventurine uses the <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> from Talent "Shot Loaded Right" or uses his Ultimate, he places an additional Bet. For every **<unbreak>3%</unbreak>** Lucky Strike Rate, there is a **<unbreak>1%</unbreak>** chance to directly trigger "The Winner Takes It All," dealing Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>1200%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF to all enemy targets.
When it is not triggered, he randomly obtains 1 to **<unbreak>9</unbreak>** points of "Injection." Upon accumulating **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** point(s), Aventurine consumes **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** point(s) of "Injection" to trigger "The Winner Takes It All."
skills.simple:
When Aventurine uses the Talent's <u>Follow-Up ATK</u> or uses Ultimate, he will place an additional Bet. The higher the Lucky Strike Rate, the more likely he is to directly trigger "The Winner Takes It All," dealing massive Imaginary DMG to all enemies.
When it is not triggered, he randomly gains "Injection." Upon accumulating **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** point(s), Aventurine will consume **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** point(s) of "Injection" to trigger "The Winner Takes It All."

skills.name: Shot Loaded Right
skills.desc:
At the start of combat, provides all on-field allies with a "Fortified Wager" Shield, which has a Shield Effect equal to **<unbreak>200%</unbreak>** of the Shield Effect provided by his Skill, lasting for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). On-field allies with "Fortified Wager" have their Effect RES increased by **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**, and after they are attacked, Aventurine gains **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** point(s) of "Blind Bet." On-field allies with "Fortified Wager" can resist <u>Crowd Control debuff(s)</u>. This effect can trigger again after **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** turn(s). After an on-field ally with "Fortified Wager" launches a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, Aventurine gains 1 point of "Blind Bet." This effect can trigger up to **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** time(s). At the start of Aventurine's turn, this effect's trigger count resets.
After reaching 7 points of "Blind Bet," Aventurine consumes 7 points of it to launch a **<unbreak>7</unbreak>**-hit <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, with each hit dealing Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF to one random enemy. He also provides all on-field allies with "Fortified Wager" that can offset DMG equal to **<unbreak>7.2%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF + **<unbreak>96</unbreak>**, and additionally grants the on-field ally target with the lowest Shield Value with "Fortified Wager" that can offset DMG equal to **<unbreak>7.2%</unbreak>** of Aventurine's DEF + **<unbreak>96</unbreak>**, lasting for 3 turns. "Blind Bet" is capped at <unbreak>10</unbreak> points.
skills.simple:
At the start of combat, provides all on-field allies with a "Fortified Wager" Shield. On-field allies with "Fortified Wager" have their Effect RES increased, and Aventurine gains "Blind Bet" after they are attacked. On-field allies with "Fortified Wager" can resist <u>Crowd Control debuff(s)</u>. After an on-field ally with "Fortified Wager" launches a <u>Follow-Up ATK</u>, Aventurine gains 1 point of "Blind Bet."
After "Blind Bet" reaches 7 points, Aventurine consumes 7 points of "Blind Bet" to launch a **<u>Follow-Up ATK</u>** that deals minor Imaginary DMG to one random enemy, bounces a total of **<unbreak>7</unbreak>** times, and provides a Shield to all on-field allies.

skills.desc: Gains "Aria": Increase DMG dealt by the ally squad by **<unbreak>25%</unbreak>**, lasting for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). This duration decreases by 1 at the start of Robin's every turn.
skills.simple: Gains "Aria": **Increases DMG** of the ally squad.

skills.name: Vox Harmonique, Opus Cosmique
skills.desc:
Robin enters the "Concerto" state and makes all teammates (i.e., excluding this unit) immediately take action.
While in the "Concerto" state, increases all allies' ATK by **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** of Robin's ATK plus **<unbreak>40</unbreak>**. Moreover, after every attack by ally targets, Robin deals Physical <u>Additional DMG</u> equal to **<unbreak>72%</unbreak>** of her ATK for 1 time, with a fixed CRIT Rate for this damage set at **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** and fixed CRIT DMG set at **<unbreak>150%</unbreak>**.
While in the "Concerto" state, Robin is immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> and cannot enter her turn or take action until the "Concerto" state ends.
A "Concerto" countdown appears in the Action Order. When the countdown's turn begins, Robin exits the "Concerto" state and immediately takes action. The countdown has its own fixed SPD of **<unbreak>90</unbreak>**.
Regenerates **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** Energy for Robin after the ally squad launches an attack. After Robin's Energy reaches its max, each attack from the ally squad will increase the SPD of the "Concerto" countdown by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple:
Enters the "Concerto" state, **increases all allies' ATK**, and causes all teammates to immediately take action. After an attack, Robin deals **Physical <u>Additional DMG</u>**. skills.name: Ode to Caress and Cicatrix
skills.desc:
Regenerates Energy by **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** of Max Energy for one designated ally character, and turns the target and their summon into "The Beatified." "The Beatified" have their SPD increased by **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>**, and when "The Beatified" exists, the ally squad's CRIT DMG increased by an amount equal to **<unbreak>24%</unbreak>** of Sunday's CRIT DMG plus **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>**.
 At the start of each of Sunday's turns, the duration of "The Beatified" decreases by 1 turn, lasting for a total of **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). And it only takes effect on the most recent target of the Ultimate. When Sunday is knocked down, "The Beatified" will also be dispelled.
skills.simple:
Regenerates **Energy** for designated on-field allies and turns the target and their summons into "The Beatified" and increases the SPD of "The Beatified." While "The Beatified" is present, the ally squad's CRIT DMG increases.
At the start of each of Sunday's turns, the duration of the "The Beatified" state decreases by 1 turn. This only takes effect on the most recent target of the Ultimate (excluding Sunday himself).

skills.desc:

skills.name: Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade
skills.desc:
Launches "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade." The first 2 hits deal Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>160%</unbreak>** of Rappa's ATK to one designated enemy and Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>** of Rappa's ATK to adjacent targets, and the 3rd hit deals Imaginary DMG equal to **<unbreak>160%</unbreak>** of Rappa's ATK to all enemies.
Enhanced Basic ATK will not recover Skill Points. Attacking enemies that don't have Imaginary Weakness can also reduce Toughness, whose effect is equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>** of the original Toughness Reduction. When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.

skills.condition: Use during action. Rappa acts at <unbreak>160%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Ninja Tech: Endurance Gauge
skills.desc:
When entering combat, Rappa initially gains **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** points of Charge. Each time an enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 Charge, and additionally gains **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** points when a boss is Weakness Broken. Each point of Charge increases Rappa's SPD by **<unbreak>2</unbreak>**. When Rappa next launches the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Break DMG equal to **<unbreak>200%</unbreak>** of Rappa's Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can ignore Weakness Type to reduce **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** Toughness, consuming all Charge. Each point of Charge increases this Break DMG multiplier by **<unbreak>70%</unbreak>**. After the attack ends, SPD and Hits Per Action are restored to their initial state.
When Breaking Weakness, triggers the Imaginary Weakness Break effect.
skills.simple: When the enemy target is Weakness Broken, Rappa gains 1 Charge and increases her SPD. When launching the third hit of "Ningu: Demonbane Petalblade," additionally deals Imaginary Break DMG to all enemies. This DMG can **ignore Weakness Type to reduce Toughness** and consume all Charge, increasing the Break DMG multiplier.

skills.name: Sword Dance of the Golden Rose
skills.desc:
When entering combat, Aglaea gains 1 stack of "Blade Dance in Bloom." While Aglaea is in the "Supreme Stance" state, she can gain "Sword Edge" from actions taken by herself and teammates. After this unit takes action, she gains **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**. After taking consecutive actions, she additionally gains **<unbreak>5%</unbreak>**. When other teammates in the ally squad take action, Aglaea gains **<unbreak>5%</unbreak>**.

When Aglaea enters the "Supreme Stance" state, she gains **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** "Sword Edge."
For every 1 stack of "Blade Dance in Bloom" Aglaea has, after using a Joint ATK, Aglaea additionally deals 1 instance of True DMG equal to **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** of the original DMG plus "Sword Edge" × **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>**.
Aglaea has a **<unbreak>25%</unbreak>** base <property type=ExtraComboRate display=icon>"Combo Rate."

skills.desc:
When the ally squad attacks, there is a **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** <u>base chance</u> for Hysilens to inflict the hit enemy target with one of the following states: Wind Shear/Bleed/Burn/Shock. Priority is given to inflicting a different state.

Triggers the "Great Boon" effect after the ally squad uses an attack, additionally dealing **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** instance(s) of **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** <u>Elation DMG</u> of the corresponding Type to all targets hit.
When triggering the "Great Boon" effect, if the Elation of the attacker is lower than Yao Guang's, this instance of <u>Elation DMG</u> is calculated based on Yao Guang's Elation.
Triggering the "Great Boon" effect is not considered as using an attack.
Yao Guang's CRIT DMG increases by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** and Elation increases by **<unbreak>150%</unbreak>**.
<u>Aha</u>'s SPD increases by **<unbreak>30</unbreak>**.

skills.name: Let Thy Fortune Burst in Flames
skills.desc: Inflicts "Woe's Whisper" on all enemies, lasting for **<unbreak>3</unbreak>** turn(s). Then, recovers **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** Skill Points for the ally squad. Increases DMG received by enemy targets under the "Woe's Whisper" state by **<unbreak>24%</unbreak>**. Deals Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> equal to **<unbreak>216%</unbreak>** to all enemies. Afterward, deals Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> equal to **<unbreak>54%</unbreak>** to one random enemy **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** time(s).
skills.simple: Increases DMG received by all enemies and recovers Skill Points for allies. Deals massive Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to all enemies, then deals Physical <u>Elation DMG</u> to one random enemy.

skills.name: Diviner's Jibe
skills.desc: While Yao Guang uses her Elation Skill, she can gain **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Aha's On/Off-Field Strength Increase, DMG Amplification, Lucky Strike Rate, Lucky Strike DMG, Break Efficiency, and Break Effect.
skills.simple: When Yao Guang uses her Elation Skill, she gains an offensive stat bonus from <u>Aha</u>.

skills.desc: When the **<u>Path of Elation ascends</u>**, the DMG multiplier of the "Great Boon" effect increases by an amount equal to **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** of its original value. After using Ultimate, Yao Guang regenerates a fixed amount of **<unbreak>12</unbreak>** Energy and gains **<unbreak>10</unbreak>** <u>Bliss</u>.

skills.name: Brushstroke: Imagenate the Starry Night
skills.desc: Gains **<unbreak>15</unbreak>** points of "<u>Certified Banger</u>," deals Ice DMG equal to **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of Pearl's DEF to all enemies, restores HP for all on-field ally targets equal to **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** of Pearl's DEF plus **<unbreak>240</unbreak>**, additionally restores HP for on-field allies with the lowest current HP percentage equal to **<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** of Pearl's DEF plus **<unbreak>240</unbreak>**, and dispels **<unbreak>1</unbreak>** <u>debuff(s)</u> from all on-field ally targets. When in possession of "<u>Certified Banger</u>", additionally deals **<unbreak>20%</unbreak>** Ice <u>Elation DMG</u> to the attacked enemy targets.

skills.condition: Use during action. Pearl acts at <unbreak>160%</unbreak> SPD.

skills.name: Appraise Soul's Ground
skills.desc:
Gains **<unbreak>30</unbreak>** point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>.". "Deep Learning" designates one on-field ally to be the "Aesthetic Archetype."
When there are 1/2/3 or more Elation characters in the ally squad, advances the "Aesthetic Archetype"'s action by **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**/**<unbreak>15%</unbreak>**/**<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**. When there are 4 or more Elation characters in the ally squad, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 1 <u>extra turn</u>. At the start of this extra turn, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains **<unbreak>30</unbreak>** point(s) of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" and **<unbreak>60</unbreak>** point(s) of <u>Punchline</u>, which are removed at the end of the extra turn.
After attacking while in "Deep Learning," additionally deals **<unbreak>80%</unbreak>** Ice <u>Elation DMG</u>. This <u>Elation DMG</u> is calculated using the "Aesthetic Archetype"'s stats.
skills.simple: Gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>." "Deep Learning" designates one on-field ally, making them the "Aesthetic Archetype." Advances the "Aesthetic Archetype"'s action forward. The more Elation characters in the squad, the more the action is advanced. When there are 4 or more Elation characters in the squad, the "Aesthetic Archetype" gains 1 extra turn, and gains <u>Punchline</u> and "<u>Certified Banger</u>" during the extra turn, which are removed at the end of the extra turn. After attacking while in "Deep Learning," additionally deals Ice <u>Elation DMG</u>. This <u>Elation DMG</u> is calculated using the "Aesthetic Archetype"'s stats.
skills.condition: Use at max Energy. After using Enhanced Basic ATK, gains <unbreak>30</unbreak> Energy.

skills.name: Dissolve Reason into Elation
skills.desc: When there are 1/2/3/4 or more Elation characters in the ally squad, then after the ally squad uses their next attack, enables them to additionally deal <u>Elation DMG</u> of their corresponding Type to the attack target, equal to **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>**/**<unbreak>15%</unbreak>**/**<unbreak>20%</unbreak>**/**<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** respectively.
skills.simple: After their next attack, the ally squad deals <u>Elation DMG</u> of their corresponding Types. The more Elation characters in the ally squad, the higher this Elation DMG.

skills.name: Grow Grace from Grit
skills.desc:
When entering combat, Pearl automatically applies "Deep Learning" to one on-field ally character, making the target the "Aesthetic Archetype." Pearl can use "<u>Certified Banger</u>" as <u>Repellency</u>. Each point of "<u>Certified Banger</u>" is equal to **<unbreak>200</unbreak>** points of <u>Repellency</u>. Repellency is affected by the Shield effect. When on-field allies take DMG, Pearl can consume Repellency to offset **<unbreak>60%</unbreak>** of the DMG for the on-field allies. Pearl's "<u>Certified Banger</u>" has an infinite duration and a maximum limit of **<unbreak>50</unbreak>** point(s).
When an on-field ally's current HP percentage is less than or equal to **<unbreak>50%</unbreak>**, DMG taken is reduced by **<unbreak>30%</unbreak>**.
When an on-field ally target's turn starts, Pearl gains **<unbreak>5</unbreak>** "<u>Certified Banger</u>," up to a maximum of **<unbreak>50</unbreak>** "<u>Certified Banger</u>". The amount of obtainable "<u>Certified Banger</u>" resets at the start of Pearl's turn. After using Ultimate, the next time the "Aesthetic Archetype" uses their Ultimate, a fixed **<unbreak>60</unbreak>** Energy is regenerated for Pearl. This effect cannot stack.
During Pearl's Elation Skill, she can gain **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** of <u>Aha</u>'s On/Off-Field Strength Increase, DMG Amplification, Lucky Strike Rate, Lucky Strike DMG, Weakness Break Efficiency, and Break Effect.
skills.simple:
When entering combat, automatically uses "Deep Learning" on one on-field ally character and designates them to be the "Aesthetic Archetype." When Pearl has "<u>Certified Banger</u>," she can consume "<u>Certified Banger</u>" to take a portion of DMG for on-field allies. When an on-field ally's current HP percentage is at a certain percentage or lower, DMG taken is reduced. At the start of the on-field ally target's turn, Pearl gains "<u>Certified Banger</u>." After using Ultimate, the next use of Ultimate by "Aesthetic Archetype" regenerates a fixed amount of Energy for Pearl.
During Pearl's Elation Skill, she can gain <u>Aha's</u> offensive stat bonuses.

stars.text: After a teammate uses an Assist Skill, the Hits Per Action of Himeko • Nova's Ultimate increases, and simultaneously gains multiple buffs under two types of "Companion Protocol." After a teammate uses their Ultimate, launches an extra Assist Skill. Off-field characters can also use Assist Skills.

skills.name: Of Fire and Far Faring
skills.desc:
While Himeko • Nova is on the field, immediately deploys the <u>Territory</u> "Starblazer Visioscape," summoning "Starblazer" to the field and granting all ally characters 1 <u>Assist Skill</u> use. Ally characters can use <u>Assist Skill</u> to command Starblazer to attack enemies.
Using <u>Assist Skill</u> is considered as Himeko • Nova using her Skill. Himeko • Nova gains **<unbreak>10%</unbreak>** increased All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> and **<unbreak>40%</unbreak>** increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, can ignore Weakness Types to reduce enemy Toughness. When breaking Weakness, triggers the Fire Weakness Break effect.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use their <u>Assist Skill</u>, regenerates **<unbreak>4</unbreak>** Energy for them, and increases the usable count of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" in Himeko • Nova's Ultimate by 1, up to a max of **<unbreak>12</unbreak>** times, resetting at the start of Himeko • Nova's turn.
skills.simple:
When Himeko • Nova is on the field, deploys a <u>Territory</u>, granting all ally characters an <u>Assist Skill</u>. When an ally character uses <u>Assist Skill</u>, Himeko • Nova gains increased All-Type <u>RES PEN</u> and increased CRIT DMG. When attacking, ignores Weakness Types to reduce Toughness.
When ally characters other than Himeko • Nova use <u>Assist Skill</u>, it regenerates Energy for them, and increases the usable count of "Hyperluminal Particle Beam" in Himeko • Nova's Ultimate.

skills.name: By Your Side
skills.desc:
After a <u>Trailblaze Companion</u> character uses an Assist Skill, Himeko • Nova always enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, additionally increases all allies' CRIT DMG by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>** and additionally increases CRIT DMG dealt by Skills by **<unbreak>100%</unbreak>**. Skill DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova is considered as Ultimate DMG.
Off-Field <u>Trailblaze Companion</u> characters can also use an <u>Assist Skill</u> when taking action, and King Pom-Pom is also considered as a <u>Trailblaze Companion</u> character.
skills.simple:
After <u>Trailblaze Companion</u> characters use an Assist Skill, Himeko • Nova enters the "Companion Protocol: Verdict" state, additionally increasing all allies' CRIT DMG and additionally increasing CRIT DMG dealt by Skills. Skill DMG dealt by Himeko • Nova is considered as Ultimate DMG.
Off-Field <u>Trailblaze Companion</u> characters can also use an <u>Assist Skill</u> when taking action.

skills.name: Wings Heed No Borders
skills.desc:
Memosprite "Summer Songbirds" has an initial Max HP equal to **<unbreak>70%</unbreak>** of Robin • Summeretto's Max HP and an initial SPD equal to **<unbreak>180%</unbreak>** of Robin • Summeretto's SPD. When an ally target uses an attack, or when they provide healing or Shield for the first time in any target's turn, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes by 1 point, capped at **<unbreak>50</unbreak>**. While "Summer Songbirds" Bessie is on the field, if Robin • Summeretto's Vibes is **<unbreak>6</unbreak>** or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie, and if Vibes is **<unbreak>12</unbreak>** or higher, immediately summons "Summer Songbirds" Paddie. When all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, dispels all <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u> inflicted upon Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds", starts the "Fever" state, and deploys a Zone. When the ally squad deals DMG within the Zone, they ignore a percentage of enemy targets' DEF equal to (**<unbreak>3%</unbreak>** + Vibes × **<unbreak>0.15%</unbreak>**), with Bond members gaining double the effect.
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.
For each target in the ally squad, the ally squad's CRIT DMG increases by **<unbreak>2%</unbreak>**.
skills.simple:
When an ally target uses an attack, or provides healing or Shield, Robin • Summeretto gains Vibes. Once Vibes reaches a certain value, summons "Summer Songbirds" Drummie and "Summer Songbirds" Paddie respectively. After all "Summer Songbirds" take the stage, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" enter the "Fever" state and deploy a Zone. When the ally squad deals DMG inside the Zone, they ignore a portion of enemy targets' DEF, which is doubled for Bond members.
While in the "Fever" state, Robin • Summeretto and the "Summer Songbirds" are immune to <u>Crowd Control debuffs</u>. Robin • Summeretto will not enter her turn until the "Fever" state ends.
The more members in the ally squad, the higher the CRIT DMG.

skills.desc: Takes effect only when the "Summon" Bond is active: For every 1 summon on the ally squad, increases the CRIT DMG of the ally squad by **<unbreak>4%</unbreak>** × <variableproperty name=ExtraSummonPower  display=icon>.
skills.simple: Takes effect only when the "Summon" Bond is active: The more summons the ally squad possesses, the higher the ally squad's CRIT DMG.

skills.name: Improvisation!

Otherwise, increases that target's CRIT DMG by (**<unbreak>12%</unbreak>** + Vibes × **<unbreak>0.4%</unbreak>**). Bond members gain double the effect.

When the "Special Guest" character or their summon attacks, additionally grants Robin • Summeretto **<unbreak>2</unbreak>** Vibes, but cannot grant other friendly targets the <u>action advance</u> effect. This lasts for 2 turns, and its duration decreases by 1 at the start of this character's turn.
